svg.title: ShelfReady — Rehearse. Verify. Release.
svg.desc: An illustrated workflow, not live job status. Three shelves carry one synthetic row from the November 5, 2026 run. Rehearse: SKU 00017 changes price from 12.30 to 13.55 and stock from 4 to 7 in a disposable store. Verify: the expected values equal the values persisted, read independently with SQL. Release: only then do the verified CSV and change report unlock. Everything is visible without animation.

g.text: The model writes the transformation. It cannot authorize a change or certify its own result.
